news.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
news.description: Indian equities plunged on Monday as the Sensex fell 1,124 points and Nifty dropped over 360 points, wiping out nearly Rs 8 lakh crore in market value. Surging oil prices, bond yields, geopolitical tensions and rate-hike concerns drove broad-based selling.

news.title: Clean Max Enviro bulk deal: Augment India divests stakes worth Rs 1,096 crore; Goldman Sachs, HSBC India among buyers
news.description: Augment India I Holdings sold 85.03 lakh Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions shares worth about Rs 1,096 crore through NSE bulk deals. Goldman Sachs, HSBC and ICICI Prudential Life Insurance were among the buyers, while brokerages retain positive views on CleanMax.

news.title: Rupee slips toward 96 vs US dollar as crude, yields and stocks weigh on currency
news.description: The rupee weakened 0.2% to 95.9825 against the dollar, pressured by surging crude oil prices, US bond yields and a sharp equity sell-off. RBI intervention likely limited losses, while concerns over inflation and India’s high oil import dependence weighed on sentiment.

news.title: Your gold or silver ETF holds physical bullion: Here's what SEBI's new vault rules mean for investors
news.description: SEBI has approved changes to its vault manager rules, bringing physical bullion underlying gold and silver ETFs under a common framework. The move strengthens requirements around how this bullion is stored, secured, segregated and accounted for.

news.title: Private school corruption case: CCB searches four places in Kallakurichi district
news.description: CCB searched four premises in Kallakurichi in a private school approvals scam probe, seizing 30 documents and bank records; key accused Muthukumar absconding.

news.title: DLSA assures legal aid to family of Gumla sexual assault victim
news.description: DLSA Gumla assures free legal aid and support to family of sexual assault victim, provides 50kg grain relief, appoints advocate, initiates compensation process.

news.title: Booked out: Karnataka colleges run short of librarians, PE teachers
news.description: Karnataka govt colleges and schools face staff shortage: 201 degree colleges lack librarians and 5,202 PE instructor posts are vacant, hurting learning and sports.

news.title: DVAC books ex-DMK minister Velu, son for illegal sand mining
news.description: DVAC books ex-DMK minister E V Velu and son for alleged illegal sand mining from Malappambadi Lake, citing conspiracy and ₹8.2 crore loss; FIR filed.

news.title: Record-high breeding for non-native birds at Pallikaranai marshland
news.description: Record breeding of non-native birds at Chennai’s Pallikaranai marsh sees highs for jacanas, fulvous whistling ducks and pied mynas amid favorable habitat.

news.title: Subsurface check dams to revive drying Ballari aquifers
news.description: Ballari plans 15 subsurface check dams costing Rs 40-50 crore to recharge aquifers and support drought-hit agriculture; first likely on Vedavathi River.

news.title: Crop loss, loan notices leave Kalaburagi farmers in a double bind
news.description: Kalaburagi farmers hit by drought crop losses face bank loan repayment notices and alleged account freezes, raising fears over access to crop insurance payouts.

news.title: Trump administration kicks off review for Ambler mining district project
news.description: The Trump administration announced last week that it will open a 30-month environmental review of a proposed open-pit copper and zinc mine, which would be accessed by the controversial 211-mile Ambler Road project.

news.title: Africa’s mineral strength is wasted if countries don’t work together – new report
news.description: Africa has the minerals to power the green transition. Capturing more value means countries must pool market power and build shared capabilities.
